mapper.sql: id, session_id, member_id, NULL AS member_nickname, joined_at
mapper.select: SELECT rsp.id, rsp.session_id, rsp.member_id, member.nickname AS member_nickname, rsp.joined_at FROM running_session_participants rsp INNER JOIN members member ON member.id = rsp.member_id WHERE rsp.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY rsp.joined_at ASC, rsp.id ASC
